dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The novels here actually aren't all that bad. But a little fried tofu and a few drinks would make things better still...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: So, little one, do you think you could pull a few strings and get your hands on some for me? Without them... I don't think I'll be able to muster the energy to help you explore this domain...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hahaha, oh, the look on your face, so dumbfounded... I'm joking, can't you tell? Do you really believe the great Lady Guuji herself would be so fickle?
